target_customer: Developers and agent builders who want AI agents to operate real iPhones and Android phones
problem: Agents cannot use phone apps that lack APIs; automating a personal phone usually needs jailbreaks, app installs or brittle tooling.
business_model: Open-source (MIT) harness with a paid managed cloud phone service
product_category: Open-source phone automation for AI agents

founders.name: Shawn Pana
education: UC San Diego, mathematics and computer science
founders.background_notes: Solo founder per YC page; authored the open-source repo.

competitors.name: Droidrun / Mobilerun
competitors.what: Open-source mobile agent framework, Android first, with iOS and cloud device workflows added by May 2026
competitors.traction_then: mirror lists about 8,171 GitHub stars (indexed date unclear)

competitors.name: mobile-use (minitap-ai)
competitors.what: Natural language phone automation for Android and iOS
competitors.traction_then: about 2,417 GitHub stars per a listing with unclear date

technical_complexity.rationale: Uses iPhone Mirroring plus Apple Vision OCR on macOS and adb with the accessibility tree on Android; clever integration rather than research, but cloud real iPhones add operational work.

defensibility.rationale: MIT licensed and copyable; open-source stars and mindshare are the main asset, and competitors like Droidrun already have more stars.

market_need_then: Agent builders want computer-use style control beyond browsers; coverage in 2026 shows rapid interest (thousands of stars) but no revenue figures are public.

branding.domain_note: Uses phone-harness.com, an exact match of the product name.
branding.brand_signature: Follows the 'Harness' naming of the founder's former employer's Browser Harness project (inferred only from similarity, not stated)
branding.community_and_virality: Covered by multiple developer blogs and AlphaSignal in 2026; has Discord and GitHub community.

brand_strength.rationale: Descriptive name with some developer press, but little distinct identity evidence.

outcome_analysis: Phone Harness is a one-person Fall 2026 YC company riding an open-source project with over 3,600 stars reported. It is too early for an outcome. The open source layer builds distribution, while revenue depends on the cloud phone offering, and competitors such as Droidrun and platform owners could close the gap.
notes: Dealroom (aggregator, Made with AI label) lists a seed round of about 125K USD with no date or investors; unverified, no round recorded. Press says the cloud service is sold but no pricing seen. No acquisition or shutdown found.
